risks.title: Cyberattacks and Information Security
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned at the top of risk factors and is subject to a formal program based on NIST CSF and CIS. The language emphasizes ongoing and increasing exposure to threats. Dedicated governance (CISO, GSC, dedicated committee) reinforces the perceived severity. Highly weighted category in the financial sector. The cybersecurity team has over 100 years of combined experience and receives ongoing training.

ai_positioning.summary: UBSI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, with no reference to AI.
